meta.name: api
meta.description: API design patterns, REST conventions, and endpoint standards. Use when creating or modifying API endpoints. Covers routing, request/response patterns, error handling, and versioning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发或修改接口
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build or maintain APIs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在 API 设计中会遵循 REST 约定：URL 表示资源而非动作，响应和错误都有统一格式，支持版本控制与向后兼容；涉及 Flask 时会用标准端点与缓存模式。
howto.when: 当你要求创建或修改 API 端点时触发；也覆盖路由、请求响应等主题。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 REST API 端点，用资源导向 URL
say.note: 会得到标准 URL 和响应信封

say.text: 给这个接口加标准错误响应格式
按缓存模式优化这个 Flask 接口
say.note: 套用 5 分钟 TTL 缓存

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude follows REST conventions when designing APIs: URLs name resources rather than actions, with unified response and error formats, and versioning with backward compatibility. For Flask projects, it applies standard endpoint and caching patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create or modify API endpoints; also covers topics like routing and request/response patterns.

say_en.text: Help me design a REST API endpoint with a resource-oriented URL.
say_en.note: Returns a standard URL and response envelope.

say_en.text: Add a standard error response format to this endpoint.
Optimize this Flask endpoint using the cache pattern.
